required_fixes.frontier_team_scope: out_of_scope — fix owned by core product lane, not frontier-query-map-ui

claim_ceiling: Zero-cost, source-validated, 174k-independent query map producing clickable bundles with OpenCaseLaw source links and clickable decision detail paths. No paid API keys. No legacy 174k global-map dependency on hot path.
evidence_summary: Pipeline run_query('test query', top_n=60) produces valid query_result_bundle v1.0 in ~1s. Bundle validation: 0 errors. /api/query/map endpoint returns bundle. Bundle adapter adaptBundleForWebGL produces WebGL data with positions, clusters, outliers, relation edges. Each decision has canonical_url (OpenCaseLaw) and citation strings. All 9 acceptance contract items pass (item 4 conditional: per-decision counter_status functional; status_counts aggregation has documented D1 shim). No 174k artifacts loaded. Prior smoke tests: test_data_smoke.py 15 passed, test_server_smoke.py 9 passed, test_browser_smoke.js 10 groups passed.
